corrections.old_text: ሉቃስ ፫ ፲፮ ግብ ፲፫ ፲ፅ ፲፯
corrections.corrected_text: ሉቃስ ፫ ፲፮ ግብ ፲፫ ፳፬ ፳፭
corrections.reason: The Ethiopic numerals ፳፬ (24) and ፳፭ (25) were misread as ፲ፅ and ፲፯ due to faded crossbars; this is the canonical cross-reference to Acts (ግብረ ሐዋርያት) 13:24-25.
The 4th-order ባ in ባየ ('when he saw', translating Ge'ez ርእዮ in 'ባየ ጊዜ') was misread as 1st-order በ.
